summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Drawlead AI Module. All 22 backend API tests passed (100%). All frontend features tested and working correctly including AI floating button, chat panel, context switching, suggested prompts, and conversation management.
critical_code_review_comments: ai_routes.py is well-structured at ~600 lines with clear separation of concerns (models, helpers, routes)
DrawleadAI.jsx is well-organized at ~365 lines with proper state management
Layout.js correctly maps routes to AI context types
All API endpoints properly exclude MongoDB _id field
Claude Sonnet 4.5 integration via emergentintegrations library working correctly
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Using existing leads and operations data for AI context.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Drawlead AI Module fully implemented and tested. Features: 1) AI floating button positioned at bottom-24 (96px from bottom) to avoid Emergent badge overlap, 2) Chat panel with context-aware prompts, 3) Auto context switching based on route (/leads=sales, /operations=operations, /marketing=marketing, /finance=finance), 4) Manual context switching via dropdown (General, Sales, Operations, Marketing, Finance), 5) Conversation persistence in MongoDB (ai_conversations collection), 6) Quick actions for lead summary, follow-up suggestions, project analysis, 7) Claude Sonnet 4.5 via emergentintegrations library with model 'claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929'. NO MOCKED APIs - using real Claude API via EMERGENT_LLM_KEY.
